name: brainstorm-reask-after-context-question
scenario: You are brainstorming a notifications feature. You just asked the user: "When a user has both email and in-app notifications enabled, should an event send both, or does in-app suppress the email if they're active?" The user replies: "hm, what do other apps usually do here?"

checks.why: re-asks the original question after answering

rubric: PASS if the response (a) actually answers what other apps do — with a concrete pattern or example — and then (b) re-asks the original either/or question for THIS app. FAIL if it just answers the meta-question and moves on, or if it picks the design itself without re-asking, or if it refuses to answer the context question.
